 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0008
 Lindsey Smith, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Oral Deposition of Lindsey Smith
Date:
July 23, 2024
Location:
Offices of Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
Examining attorney:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defending attorney:
Andrew Lewis, Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rahter not give my name in the transcript, so you can just refer to me as the plaintiff.
Q: Fine. Let's begin with the collision itself. Where were you when it happened?
A: I was in a parking lot in Baytown, Texas, pulling into a space near the store entrance.
Q: Were you moving or stopped at the time of impact?
A: I was moving slowly, maybe walking speed, looking for an open spot. Then a vehicle backed into the driver's side of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?
A: No. I heard a horn and then felt the jolt. My head sanpped forward and then back against the headrest.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?
A: Yes, but I felt unsteady and sat down on the curb for a while. Someone at the store brought me water.
Q: When did you first notice pain in your neck?
A: That evening. I figured it was just stiffness from the jolt, but by the next morning I couldn't turn my head to the left without
sharp pain.
Q: Did you seek medical care?
A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic the following day. They diagnosed whiplash and gave me a soft collar and muscle relaxers.
Q: Have you continued treatment since then?
A: I've had physical therapy twice a week for several months. I also saw a chiropractor for a while, but I stopped that after a few
visits because it didn't help much.
Q: How has the injury affected your daily life?
A: It's hard to drive for long stretches. I used to coach my nephew's soccer team on weekends, and I had to hand that over to my
brother. Sleeping is also difficult because I wake up with pain in my upper back.
Q: Have you missed any work?
A: I've taken some sick days and worked a modified schedule for a few weeks. My job involves a lot of lifting, so I was restricted
from heavy tasks for a while.
Q: Do you have any prior neck or back problems?
A: I had some mild neck stiffness years ago after a long desk job, but nothing that required a doctor or time off.
</page>
